question: To which revilers of sacred figures must the teaching never be given?
premises: A reviler of Shiva is explicitly excluded
A slanderer of the Kula Bhairava is excluded
The prohibition is addressed to the goddess
inference: Therefore, the teaching must not be given to those who revile Shiva or slander the Kula Bhairava.
plain_english: O Goddess, it must not be given to one who reviles Shiva or slanders the Kula Bhairava.
